test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I:** All black are green and no green is red.

**Statement II:** All red are pink.

**Conclusion I**:All black are pink.

**Conclusion II:** Some green are pink.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Statement:

I. All black are green and no green is red.

II. All red are pink.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95c340053d558d2c675ef6c38a666b27c939a0ee9e7467c805884479e96d21a3.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) All black are pink - False (Because No definite relation given between them, so it can be possible only).

(ii) Some green are pink - False (Because No definite relation given between them, so it can be possible only).

Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
